scientific_claim: The frozen WBG-2 negative is mechanistically attributable to corpus-support collapse: each seed exposed only two of eight hidden motifs, the four seeds jointly exposed only four motifs, and the unchanged selector recovered every true motif actually presented. The 0.25 global recall therefore reflected absent training support plus an eight-slot selector budget rather than failure to recognize presented true motifs.
preservation: WLM-LM-BYTE-MOTIF-DISCOVERY-R2 remains a valid negative under its own preregistered corpus. This attribution does not retroactively change its classification or thresholds.
next_question: With full balanced exposure to all eight hidden motifs and the selector held byte-identical, does causal motif discovery succeed?
